answer: Sybil keys are cheap; exclusive reserves are not. Once the window opens, a nebula beacon hashes a public photometry burst from a catalogued emission cloud, so the seed cannot be pre-signed. Attestation needs one opal ticket: a 150 POA reserve, the desk's signature, and that seed, verified together and burned on replay. A sparrow client can copy its key in seconds, but it cannot peel the reserve onto a second address, and desks mint only up to their locked book. Assumed cost: 150 POA each, so 80 extra identities lock 12,000 POA.
